structured.reason: The wrapper is meant to block only new work once the attempt is left, and stay transparent otherwise. If capabilities returns None, an attempt run under an attempt timeout no longer sees its provider's capabilities, so capability-dependent steps of that attempt can break or behave differently. This changes what the caller gets back from the route, which this requirement covers.
